style: real top-down studio photograph, warm natural colour, plain white background
themeWhy: a kilogram of rice in a jute sack and fruit in a basket: the same kraft-paper keys as Weigh It and Measure It (the tan of the jute sack), with the magenta-marker Enter as a watermelon-pink treat, soft cream keys and a very light panel; no red, no violet.

images.object: plain jute sack of rice tied at the top with twine, standing upright
images.why: Look "a real bag of salt" on the scale pan and Pour "opens each kilogram bag": the one-kilogram bag of rice sitting on the scale pan (phases 1 to 3), drawn once per kilogram, and the empty kilogram bags that wait to be filled when Gather runs (phase 2); the 1 kg label is drawn in code on it. Also the rice bag among the shopping items of phase 4.
images.prompt: A single plump jute sack filled with rice, standing upright, closed and tied at the top with a rough twine knot; coarse natural beige burlap weave with a slightly crumpled, soft fall, and nothing printed on it.

images.object: single whole ripe mango with a golden-yellow skin and a soft red-orange blush, side on
images.why: Look "two shopping baskets ... a basket of fruit in natural colours" (phase 4): the light shopping item, about 250 g to 500 g, one whole mango in a basket.
images.prompt: A single whole ripe mango with smooth golden-yellow skin shading to a soft red-orange blush near the top, a short green-brown stalk, and tiny natural freckles on the skin; plump, kidney-shaped and glossy.

images.object: whole oval watermelon with dark and pale green stripes, side on
images.why: Look "two shopping baskets ... a basket of fruit in natural colours" (phase 4): the heavy shopping item, about 2 kg to 3 kg, one whole watermelon in a basket.
images.prompt: A single whole oval watermelon, deep green with lighter green wavy stripes, a glossy waxy rind and a small dry brown stalk at one end; heavy, fresh and uncut.

images.object: plain medium tan khaki cotton canvas tote bag with two handles, standing upright
images.why: The shopping tote that holds the left-over amount in Weight Converter (phase 1 question 2 "700 g", question 3 "90 g", phase 4 question 3 "5 kg 50 g"), drawn beside the jute sack, the mango and the watermelon; the amount is written over it in code.
images.prompt: A single plain cotton canvas tote bag standing upright, a medium warm tan-khaki colour like unbleached canvas, with a soft matte woven texture and gentle natural creases, two wide flat darker tan fabric handles rising from the top edge in arches, gently full and rounded as if holding something soft, and nothing printed on it.
